strings: m_c has always been easily influenced by others due to their need for approval. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have histrionic personality disorder.
m_c's theatrical personality has only gotten more intense over the moons, leading the clan to believe {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have histrionic personality disorder.
When r_c calmly criticises something that m_c does, m_c breaks down sobbing in an overdramatic way. m_c may have histrionic personality disorder.

m_c keeps acting out, deliberately disobeying orders just to get attention, and r_c is fed up with it. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} should have grown out of this by now, but the fact that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/haven't/hasn't) indicates that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have histrionic personality disorder.
m_c falls into a deep depression when r_c gets attention instead of {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
When m_c finally gets dragged to r_c's den after intentionally causing a problem yet again, r_c diagnoses {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with histrionic personality disorder.
